args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24%, making returns a major cost driver in retail logistics (source: blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns).
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (~20%) compared to distributed processing (source: blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin, making speed of resale a key lever (source: insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion).
